newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African energy policy paper seen ready this year.
newsitem.headline: S.African energy policy paper seen ready this year.

text.p: The long-awaited South African energy policy white paper could be finalised this year, Minerals and Energy Department chief director of energy Johann Basson said on Wednesday.
Although this is further away from finalisation than many in the oil industry would like, Basson outlined some of the factors that would have to be taken into consideration in any new energy policy.
Briefing the National Council of Provinces economic and foreign affairs committee, Basson said the draft white paper on energy policy "is just about complete in internal form".
"We hope to hand this to the Minister by the end of the month. Whether he will be happy with it as it is...and whether there are changes, I am not sure."

Following criticism last year by the International Energy Agency about the weakness in the department's energy policies, Basson said the chief directorate on energy had been upgraded to a branch but it was severely lacked skilled people.
"There is intense debate taking place in the energy sector in terms of policy," Basson said. "Much of this is contentious. Many of the stakeholders have totally diverse opinions."
Whatever changes were made would, however, have to take into consideration changes that were taking place globally in the energy sector.
